_schema.description: Manual team-level draft context overlay. Keep sourced and dated when populated.

fields.ocChange: boolean; true when the offensive coordinator changed materially for this season
fields.playCallerChange: boolean; true when the likely offensive play caller changed
fields.offensiveLineRank: number; lower is better, overall offensive line rank
fields.runBlockRank: number; lower is better, run-blocking context for RBs
fields.passBlockRank: number; lower is better, pass-protection context for QBs/deep-route WRs
fields.schemeNote: short note visible in player/tooltips once wired
fields.sourceUrls: array of source URLs used to maintain the note
